scope: Shared value-learning decision diagnostics, not KDA-specific attribution.
original_T1_T4_spec: NOT LOCATED; this supplement does not amend an unidentified 34-hour plan.
probes: Existing reference-policy shared-window states; reference original KDA top two unmasked V candidates excluding index0, selected without looking at compared seeds.
index0: Reselect top two from indices 1..79; retain original pair and replacement flag.
M: gamma*(V(a1)-V(a0)); no hard mask, risk, index0 bias, or immediate reward.
centered_disagreement: For each state, median_a |gamma*(V419-mean(V419)) - gamma*(V443-mean(V443))|; then median over states.
pooled_disagreement: Also report point median over all state-candidate entries.
gate: Any primary ratio >=1 cancels sign-only timeline training on this probe population; both upper95<1 passes this budget gate only; otherwise HOLD. No automatic training.
caution: Seed disagreement is not repeated-estimator noise of a verified identical V^pi; even a large ratio does not prove sign disagreement, causation, or value compression.

closedloop_acceptance.interpretation: User-imposed resource threshold, NOT a statistical MDE or seed-noise floor.
closedloop_acceptance.sample_size_and_power: UNVERIFIED until discordant paired outcomes, alpha, power, families, and protection/noninferiority margins are specified.
closedloop_acceptance.below_threshold: No GO; not engineering FIX merely because efficacy is unverified.

resolution: Use actual branch G as primary comparator; terminal-arrival-only gamma^(L-1) difference only for common-success, unequal-duration pairs. Other rewards reported separately. Signed and absolute gains both retained.
